# MetroFuse 10.0 Beta 2

Spicy Lyrics joins MetroFuse's online lyrics sources. The default lookup order starts with Better Lyrics, Spicy Lyrics, then MetroFuse Lyrics. Spicy Lyrics uses the song's metadata to match the Spotify track and shows contributor credits with community syncs.

Install the signed Android APK over an existing matching MetroFuse installation, or extract the Windows x64 ZIP into a new folder and run the included MetroFuse launcher.
